//: Adds an 'M4 GL/SSC' cosmetic variant to the vanilla modular M4 lower, exactly the way 'm4_cqbr' (Mk 18) is defined on this same gun. The variant is purely a display name/description; the actual configuration is realized by the parts installed in the m4_glssc item_group below.

variants.description: A door-kicker's M4 built around the Daniel Defense GL/SSC: a 12.5-inch upper receiver that splits the difference between a full M4 and a stubby CQBR, mated to an M203 grenade launcher under the barrel and a short suppressor on the muzzle.  Feeds from standard STANAG magazines.

//: Mirrors the 'm4_cqbr' item_group: spawns the modular M4 lower wearing the m4_glssc variant with its respective parts pre-installed — the GL/SSC 12.5-inch upper, an M203 stand-off launcher, a short suppressor, a pistol grip, and a collapsible stock. All parts remain removable/swappable, just like a Mk 18 spawned this way.
